purpose: Compare persistent external-endpoint S2 against conventional-only and eager-dual policies on identical natural channel traces and the same GPU/process budget.

shared_contract.endpoint_lifecycle: persistent during each timed epoch; MPS restart and requalification between policies

policies.conventional: run conventional full path; keep the initialized external endpoint idle during the timed epoch
policies.eager: run external NeuralRx and conventional full path for every request; select NeuralRx when valid, otherwise conventional
policies.s2: reuse frozen confirm33: run external NeuralRx first and conventional only on NeuralRx verification failure

interpretation_limit: Saved conventional executions are a direct compute-efficiency measure. Translating all saved time into background throughput is evaluated separately with an external background lease.
